environment.description: Same application deployed with PgBouncer 1.21 in transaction pooling mode with server-side prepared statement disabling (server_reset_query = DISCARD ALL; disable_prepared_statements = yes) sitting between the app and PostgreSQL. PgBouncer is configured with a custom query filter via pgbouncer-rr (routing/rewriting extension) that enforces parameterized query detection: any query containing unescaped single quotes outside of $N parameter markers is rejected at the pooler level with a connection reset. Additionally, the upstream proxy is Envoy 1.28 configured with HTTP connection manager using envoy.filters.http.header_to_metadata with a custom Lua filter that strips any request containing both Transfer-Encoding and Content-Length headers (returning 400), and normalize_path is enabled. The Envoy HTTP/1.1 codec is set to allow_chunked_length: false which rejects ambiguous framing.

config.proxy: Envoy 1.28 HTTP connection manager, allow_chunked_length: false, custom Lua filter rejecting TE+CL coexistence, normalize_path: true
config.database: PgBouncer 1.21 transaction mode with pgbouncer-rr query rewriting extension enforcing parameterized-only queries (rejects raw string interpolation containing unescaped quotes)
config.pgbouncer_config: server_reset_query = DISCARD ALL; disable_prepared_statements = yes; custom_filter = reject_non_parameterized
